title: Luxury 3BR East Nashville Rooftop | Skyline Views
description:
Immerse yourself in luxury at this modern East Nashville rooftop retreat, just minutes from downtown, Nissan Stadium, Top Golf. Enjoy 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and stunning skyline views. Safe and serene, with vibrant dining and nightlife nearby. Book now for an unforgettable experience!

Reach out and ask for special promotion for your dates! Additional guests accommodation available.

The space
The home is 3 beds, 2,.5 baths, and sleeps 10 comfortably(with 2 additional inflatable beds and 2 sofa beds ). You'll have access to the second and third floors via a separate entrance for complete privacy. 

MASTER BEDROOM
The second floor has a spacious master bedroom w/ KING bed with TV, desk & large walk-in closet. The ensuite bathroom w/walk-in shower is equipped with towels, shampoo, conditioner, soap, and blow dryer.

GUEST ROOM SINGLE QUEEN
The second bedroom has a Queen bed with an ensuite jack and jill full bath to share with the additional room across the hall. 

GUEST ROOM DOUBLE QUEENS
The third bedroom has two Queen beds and a large closet.

LIVING AREAS
On the 3rd floor, you can find a large living room with a half bath, dining, and kitchen areas that open into a spacious rooftop with sunset views.

There are two parking spots available at the back of the house. Please park there, don’t use parking in front of the house.

Guest access
Guests will have private access to the second and third floors with a separate private entrance located at the back of the home. Rest assured you’re completely safe, my home is equipped with: smoke-detectors, carbon monoxide detector, fire extinguisher, flashlight, and a first-aid kit.

Other things to note
I want your stay in Nashville to be the best experience possible. I am generally on-site (on the first floor) if there's anything you need. Your space is approx 1600sq ft, so there's plenty of room! 

*** There are 2 outdoor security cameras which is actively recording audio and video overlooking front and back yard to keep the property safe.

***No shoes in the house.

***Quiet hours 10pm-10am.

***No smoking inside the house or rooftop

***Keep exterior doors & windows closed and locked at all times.
